orientations.intent: State whether the frozen tools can query a remote Go module proxy for this dependency.

final_message:
Based on this environment: the tools available are frozen local operations (repo, tests, git, episodes) with no network-capable verb exposed. There is no tool here that can reach out to a remote Go module proxy (e.g., proxy.golang.org) — all actions operate on the local repository/test/git state only.

**Answer: No.** The frozen toolset provides no network/proxy-query capability; it cannot contact a remote Go module proxy for this or any dependency. Any resolution of the dependency would have to rely on information already present locally (go.mod/go.sum, vendored files, or cached module data in the repo).
